description: This file defines background work constraints and a no-operation worker class for testing WorkManager integration; it provides utility functions to create work requests with specific constraints.

classes.name: NoopWorker
classes.description: A placeholder worker that performs no operations, used for validation and testing the WorkManager setup.

methods.name: heavyWorkConstraints
methods.description: Constraints specifying that device must be charging and not low on battery for heavy work.

methods.name: lightWorkConstraints
methods.description: Constraints specifying that device should not be low on battery for light work.

methods.name: oneTimeRequestLight
methods.description: Creates a one-time work request with light work constraints.

methods.name: oneTimeRequestHeavy
methods.description: Creates a one-time work request with heavy work constraints.
